    body=response.read()
metadata=json.loads(body)

    raise RuntimeError(f'Unexpected package metadata: {metadata!r}')
expected_path=metadata.get('install',{}).get('path')

(root/'acme-fixlib.pkg').write_bytes(body)
config['version']=version
